item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 20 September 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad) and Nueva Ecija (General Tinio) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Nueva Ecija (Gabaldon) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
